description: This file contains Spring Security configuration for the pricing-service, setting up OAuth2 resource server with JWT validation, and defining security filter chains.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class that sets up security filters for the pricing service, including JWT validation via OAuth2.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines and configures the security filter chain for the application, disabling CSRF, permitting certain endpoints publicly, and securing others with OAuth2 JWT tokens.
